network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto documenta gli effetti torrentizi nell'alta Valle Cervo, ma non pubblica una sezione idrometrica sul Cervaro compatibile con questo ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The report documents torrential effects in the upper Cervo valley but publishes no Cervaro gauge section compatible with this bridge.

curation_note.it: La piena e i processi torrentizi della Valle Cervo sono documentati, ma non esiste nel rapporto una misura attribuibile al Cervaro o alla sezione del ponte.
curation_note.en: Flooding and torrential processes in the Cervo valley are documented, but the report contains no measurement attributable to the Cervaro or bridge section.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official ARPA Piemonte event report

caveats: The official event report was reviewed and contains no hydrometric observation compatible with this bridge and watercourse.
A geographically nearby station must not be treated as hydraulically representative without watercourse and network verification.
The encoded failure process retains its database evidence level and does not prove causation beyond the cited sources.
Rainfall reanalysis, when available, remains a separate meteorological context and is not converted into discharge.
